title: Time-fractional nonlinear evolution equations with time-dependent constraints
summary: This article is devoted to developing an abstract theory of time-fractional gradient flow equations for time-dependent convex functionals in real Hilbert spaces. The main results concern the existence of strong solutions to time-fractional abstract evolution equations governed by subdifferential operators of time-dependent convex functionals. In the classical theory of gradient flow equations, chain-rule formulae play a crucial role in various analyses, and such formulae for subdifferentials of time-dependent functionals are also known in the case of first-order time derivatives.
